official_elo.description: Only classified Olympics, Tour de Ski/Stage World Cup, World Cup, and World Championship results update accepted Elo.

prediction_elo.eligible_athlete: An athlete with no classified A-tier result strictly before the prediction-evidence race date.
prediction_elo.comparison_opponents: A-tier-verified athletes in the same classified race only.
prediction_elo.first_a_tier_result: Stop domestic prediction updates and use accepted official Elo for both actual and prediction Elo.

national_source_fallback: Use a reviewed national source only when the race is absent from FIS, under the identical fixed-anchor comparison contract.
